tutorials.title: Bulk Enrichment Analysis
tutorials.description: Bulk RNA-seq workflow on GSE151251 (dc.ds.hsctgfb: 6 hepatic stellate cell samples, 3 control vs 3 TGF-beta): edgeR-style gene filtering, PCA/metadata association QC, PyDESeq2 Wald test (treatment vs control), and ulm activity scoring with CollecTRI TFs, PROGENy pathways and MSigDB Hallmark gene sets, with volcano, bar, dot, network, source-target scatter and leading-edge plots.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Matches the exact requested filter; contains complete, executed user tasks applicable to a new bulk count matrix with treatment/control metadata.

suggested_tools.description: Remove lowly profiled genes from a raw bulk count matrix (edgeR filterByExpr logic) and inspect threshold choice.
suggested_tools.primary_input: raw counts + sample metadata; group_key (metadata column, optional, tutorial 'condition'); min_count=10, min_total_count=15, large_n=10, min_prop=0.7 (tutorial values = API defaults); lib_size optional (API param, None).
suggested_tools.outputs: filtered counts (h5ad keeping obs) for downstream DE; kept-gene list/count; threshold diagnostic PNG (log10 total counts vs number of samples with dashed cutoffs).

suggested_tools.description: Explore sample variability: PCA on normalised counts and test association of each PC with each metadata column (ANOVA for categorical, Spearman for numeric, BH-adjusted) to identify covariates for the DE design.
suggested_tools.primary_input: filtered (or raw) counts + metadata; obs_keys optional (rankby_obsm API param; default all metadata columns); color_keys for PCA scatter (tutorial ['condition','sample_id']); nvar=5 for association plot.
suggested_tools.outputs: PC x metadata association table (obsm, obs, stat, pval, padj); explained-variance ratios; PNGs: PCA variance ratio, dc.pl.obsm association heatmap, PCA scatter coloured by metadata.

suggested_tools.description: Differential expression between two user-specified groups with PyDESeq2 (Wald test), giving the gene-level statistics used for enrichment.
suggested_tools.primary_input: filtered counts + metadata (output of decoupler_filter_genes_by_expression); condition_key, group (numerator), reference (denominator); design formula optional (default '~{condition_key}', must contain condition_key; covariates must exist in metadata); n_cpus (runtime only). refit_cooks=True fixed as in tutorial.
suggested_tools.outputs: results table indexed by gene: baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj (CSV); volcano PNG (x=log2FoldChange, y=padj, top=10).

suggested_tools.source_section: cell 28 (exec 14); cells 30/32/34 (exec 15-17) CollecTRI; cells 40/42/44/46 (exec 20-23) PROGENy; cells 52/54/56/58 (exec 26-29) Hallmark
suggested_tools.description: Infer TF / pathway / Hallmark activities for a contrast by running ulm on the gene-level DE statistic against a chosen prior-knowledge network.
suggested_tools.primary_input: DE results table (gene index) with stat_column (default 'stat'); network in {collectri, progeny, hallmark} (organism fixed to human); contrast_name (default f'{group}.vs.{reference}' or user value; tutorial 'treatment.vs.control'); padj_threshold=0.05; barplot top (tutorial 25 for CollecTRI/PROGENy, 10 for Hallmark); dotplot top=10.
suggested_tools.outputs: full scores and BH-adjusted p-values for all sources (long table: source, score, padj, significant); significance-filtered subset; barplot PNG; dotplot PNG (score vs source, size -log10 padj clipped at 2.22e-16); network snapshot size (rows) for provenance.

suggested_tools.source_section: cell 36 (exec 18) network; cell 38 (exec 19) volcano SRF; cell 48 (exec 24) source_targets TGFb; cell 50 (exec 25) leading_edge TGFb +/-; cell 60 (exec 30) leading_edge TGF_BETA_SIGNALING
suggested_tools.description: Explain an activity score by inspecting the target genes of selected TFs/pathways: target volcano, weight-vs-statistic scatter, leading-edge genes, and a regulator-target network graph.
suggested_tools.primary_input: DE results table; network in {collectri, progeny, hallmark}; source name(s) chosen by the user from scoring results (tutorial SRF / TGFb / TGF_BETA_SIGNALING; network plot sources SRF, MYOCD, IRF1, SKIL); optional activity-score table from decoupler_score_activities_ulm for the network plot.
suggested_tools.outputs: leading-edge gene lists (split into positive/negative weight components when the network has signed weights, as in cell 50; single list for unweighted sets, as in cell 60); PNGs: target volcano (x=log2FoldChange, y=pvalue, top=10), source_targets scatter (x=weight, y=stat, top=15; weighted networks only), leading-edge plot(s), network plot (targets=10, by_abs=True, vcenter=True, size_node=10).
